name: Innshift
summary: A complete HR and rota app for a hotel group, with a 24-hour rota wheel, hiring and payroll
about: A ten-page HR and staff-rota app for a hotel group or any business that runs on shifts, with light and dark themes and sample data. A 24-hour wheel shows every department's shifts as arcs around the clock with a live hand. Plan the week by dragging shifts, hire through a drag-and-drop board that creates onboarding checklists, approve time off, rate the team in a review cycle and run payroll with payslips.
how: Switch hotel in the sidebar workspace box (or view all three) and open pages from the sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
On Dashboard, pick a weekday to redraw the 24-hour wheel; hover an arc to see who works it. The red hand shows the time now.
On Rota, drag shifts between people and days (Alt copies, M moves with the keyboard), add shifts, then copy, auto-fill, clear or publish.
On Hiring, drag a candidate through the stages; dropping on Hired adds them to People with an onboarding checklist.
On Onboarding, tick tasks and watch each ring fill; on Reviews, click stars to rate someone and finish their review.
On Time off and Payroll, approve requests, adjust and approve the run, pay it and open any payslip.
